Twilio Voice JavaScript SDK 2.x is not bundled in this archive.
The official SDK is available from the Twilio Voice JavaScript SDK GitHub releases.
Download the latest stable release and locate dist/twilio.min.js.
Upload that file in the portal's Admin Settings (Vendor SDK upload), or copy it here.
https://github.com/twilio/twilio-voice.js/releases
This application intentionally DOES NOT use an unsupported CDN or an obsolete Twilio SDK 1.x.
